verdict: No concrete reader defect found against frozen character-memory/1.0.0 contracts within reviewed scope

cases: party filtering and pagination across 1/7/128 limits
earliest acquisition recency despite repeated grants
proxy source rejection without trap execution

reviewed_properties: Only authenticated viewer actor gets its own profile and latest impression per subject; traveler does not receive others impressions
First acquired sequence determines the bounded latest16 experiences; repeated grants do not refresh perception; returned experience rows remain in source order
Narrator party requires current viewer/traveler membership and exact same-party viewer acquisition, filtered before pagination
Queries, principal, source projection and outputs enforce scope and exact current cursor; passive DTO checks run before explicit cloning
Cutoff emits no narrator records or continuation, including after refreshing source projection
Complete narrator private history remains pageable without a lifetime cap; internal history is not passed through public DTOs

limitations.detail: Authentication of Principal, signature verification, actual witnessed perception, truthful acquisition/predecessor history and source freshness remain responsibilities of the privileged host/projection provider, as frozen spec states. The shape validator cannot establish them.

The trusted async projection callback is executable host code. JavaScript Promise resolution may inspect a returned thenable/proxy before this reader receives it; no arbitrary-host-code isolation is claimed. Direct query and principal passive DTO boundaries were tested separately.

Readers bind one fresh projection during a call. Narration must independently refresh/recompare context before delivering asynchronous generated prose, as specified; that adapter is outside this lane.

This isolated commit adds src/characters.ts without exporting createCharacterViews through @argo/lexi-bridge package root; root integration must add its planned barrel export. Current tests import the module directly.
Projection validation, cloning and selection scan complete in-memory history on each request. This review tests correctness, not archival-scale performance or external-service integration.

excluded: No runtime authority implementation or live provider calls reviewed
No Board mutations, source edits, pushes, policy-root changes or operational approval performed
